title: Rewards Partner LATAM
description:
About the role

Leads the execution of the Total Rewards agenda across Latin America, translating strategy into impactful and scalable compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs that support Kerry's business and people priorities. This role partners closely with HR and business leaders to deliver market-competitive reward solutions, ensuring a seamless balance between employee experience, operational excellence, compliance, and cost effectiveness. Through strong stakeholder management, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement, the role drives consistent delivery, fosters cross-functional collaboration, and ensures Rewards programs create meaningful value for employees and the business.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Rewards Partner

  • Act as the trusted Rewards advisor to HR and business leaders across LATAM, translating global Rewards strategies into practical regional solutions that support business growth, talent priorities, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partner with HR Leadership Teams and business stakeholders to develop and execute Rewards programs that attract, retain, motivate, and engage talent while ensuring market competitiveness and internal equity.
  • Provide strategic guidance on compensation, benefits, recognition, incentive, and workforce planning matters, balancing business needs, employee experience, governance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Leverage market intelligence, analytics, and external benchmarking to identify trends, assess risks, and inform reward-related decisions.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives, including restructures, acquisitions, integrations, and talent-related projects, ensuring Rewards considerations are effectively incorporated into business decisions.

Rewards Centre of Excellence Partner

  • Partner with Global Rewards and regional HR teams to implement and sustain Rewards programs, policies, frameworks, and governance across LATAM.
  • Drive the regional delivery of annual Rewards processes including salary reviews, incentive plans, market pricing, job architecture, pay transparency, and benefits governance.
  • Ensure Rewards programs remain compliant with local legislation, company policies, and regulatory requirements across the countries within scope.
  • Lead the assessment, design, and continuous improvement of Rewards programs to enhance employee value proposition, operational effectiveness, and cost management.
  • Develop and execute communication and change management strategies that improve understanding and adoption of Rewards programs among leaders, HR teams, and employees.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and coaching to HRBPs and people leaders on Rewards philosophy, policies, tools, and decision-making frameworks.

Business & Operational Execution

  • Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Global Rewards, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation of Rewards initiatives.
  • Support data-driven decision making through analysis, insights, and recommendations related to compensation, benefits, workforce costs, and talent outcomes.
  • Monitor Rewards program effectiveness through KPIs, market benchmarking, employee feedback, and governance reviews, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Drive high-quality execution of Rewards projects and processes, ensuring consistency, service excellence, and alignment with regional and global priorities.
  • Contribute to the development of regional guidelines, policies, and governance frameworks that enable scalable and sustainable Rewards practices across LATAM.

Qualifications and skills

• A Bachelor’s degree (Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business or other applicable field)

• Minimum of ten (10) years broad based human resources experience, with significant experience at influencing; Experience in the food/flavours manufacturing industry desirable

• English, Portuguese and Spanish language capability (fluent in writing, speaking)

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Agente comercial | Uberlândia
description:
#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . title: Líder de Equipe Externo- Mercado Pago - Vale do Paraíba - SP
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil.
  • Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima.
  • Colaborar para o desenvolvimento da proposta de valor e estratégia do segmento.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Ter experiência consistente de vendas em empresas adquirentes ou de entregas porta a porta.
  • Conhecer profundamente a região de atuação;
  • Experiência consistente em liderar equipes comerciais;
  • Possuir CNH "B” e automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.

No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Religião, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQ+, Etnia e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa. Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Consultor(a) Logística - Planejamento S&OE (Santos/SP)
description:
Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Sobre a Função

Liderar e otimizar o alinhamento de curto prazo entre as áreas de Vendas, Operações (Produção) e Logística atuando como elo central na tomada de decisões táticas, garantindo que a execução do plano de produção esteja perfeitamente sincronizada com a demanda do mercado, o estoque disponível e a capacidade de expedição, maximizando a rentabilidade, garantindo o nível de serviço ao cliente e otimizando a eficiência da cadeia, visualizando um horizonte de planejamento de 3 a 18 meses.

Principais Atividades :

  • Liderar o ciclo de reuniões de S&OE, atuando como facilitador entre Vendas, Produção, Logística e demais áreas;
  • Consolidar informações de demanda, capacidade, restrições e estoque, garantindo um plano integrado e alinhado aos objetivos da empresa;
  • Gerenciar prioridades e conflitos entre áreas, assegurando decisões ágeis e estratégicas;
  • Analisar e melhorar continuamente o desempenho dos planos de S&OE, propondo ações corretivas;
  • Replanejar produção e estoques diante de mudanças de mercado ou imprevistos operacionais;
  • Desenvolver análises e simulações de cenários para apoiar decisões de curto prazo;
  • Definir, monitorar e reportar KPIs como acuracidade da previsão, nível de estoque, OTD e eficiência produtiva;
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios e dashboards gerenciais sobre desempenho da cadeia de suprimentos;
  • Ser ponto focal dos sistemas de planejamento (ERP, APS) e garantir integridade dos dados;
  • Atuar na identificação e implementação de melhorias nos processos de S&OE, buscando agilidade, precisão e automação;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança, Ética e Compliance.

Requisitos Obrigatórios :

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas afins;
  • Especialização ou pos graduação em Logística empresarial, Papel e Celulose, Supply Chain Management ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento com Planejamento de demanda, Logística Integrada, Processos portuários, ERP/Sistemas, KPIs e performance;
  • Pacote office nível avançado;
  • Vivência em indústrias de processo contínuo, como papel e celulose, química, mineração, siderurgia, alimentos, automotivo, varejo alta escala ou petroquímica;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de planejamento (ERP, APS) e ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Domínio de processos de planejamento de Supply Chain (S&OE, S&OP, planejamento de demanda, planejamento de capacidade);
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão (ERP, como SAP APO, S/4HANA ou outros módulos de planejamento);
  • Conhecimento em estatística e métodos de previsão de demanda;
  • Desejável Inglês nível avançado;
  • Desejável Espanhol nível básico;
  • Disponibilidade para eventuais viagens;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em Santos/SP.

title: Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)

About Us

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.

Role Purpose

This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite (the team's go-forward systems); willingness and ability to learn additional legacy systems as needed
  • Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required
  • High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems
  • Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support

Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management

  • Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases
  • Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments
  • Monitor licence allocation and usage; identify under- or over-utilised licences
  • Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased; audit and reconcile entitlements
  • Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions
  • Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility
  • Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements

Billing & Invoice Support

  • Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution
  • Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly
  • Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas
  • Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records
  • Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests

Data Quality & Master Data Management

  • Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records
  • Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements
  • Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms
  • Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections

Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management

  • Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches
  • Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues
  • Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs

Reporting

  • Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team)
  • Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting

Service Expectations

  • Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies; flag gaps before they affect the customer
  • Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability
  • Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs
  • Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
The HR Generalist serves as a trusted partner to leaders and employees across assigned regions and client groups, helping translate business priorities into effective people practices and employee experiences. They collaborate across Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Total Rewards, HR Operations, and HRIS to design, implement, and continuously improve people programs and processes. Acting as both a strategic contributor and operational expert, the HR Generalist helps drive consistency, scalability, and adoption of global HR initiatives while balancing local business needs. Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary HR contact for assigned leaders and employee populations, providing guidance and support across all stages of the employee lifecycle.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to support workforce planning, candidate evaluation, interviewing, selection, hiring decisions, and onboarding activities.
  • Conduct and document employee relations investigations, resolve workplace concerns, and recommend fair, consistent, and compliant outcomes.
  • Coach managers and employees on performance management, feedback, career development, conflict resolution, communication, and workplace effectiveness.
  • Facilitate onboarding experiences, manager training, employee workshops, and learning programs that support capability building and career growth.
  • Support talent management activities including talent reviews, succession planning, development planning, high-potential identification, and employee growth initiatives.
  • Serve as a local subject matter expert for compensation programs, benefits offerings, leave administration, HR operations processes, and employee programs.
  • Help design, implement, and drive adoption of global HR initiatives, programs, policies, frameworks, and best practices across regions and business functions.
  • Partner with HR Centers of Excellence to continuously improve people processes, employee experiences, and operational efficiencies.
  • Conduct HR compliance reviews, audits, and documentation assessments to ensure adherence to company policies and employment regulations.
  • Utilize HR systems, workforce analytics, engagement data, and employee insights to identify trends, recommend solutions, and support data-informed decision making.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance across HR systems and processes.
  • Build relationships and credibility across all levels of the organization while serving as an advocate for positive culture, inclusion, accountability, and employee experience.
  • Maintain full-time onsite presence.
  • Provide support to additional locations, regions, or business functions as needed.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

  • Education: Undergraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: SHRM-CP, PHR, SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or other relevant HR certification preferred but not required.
  • Experience: 4+ years of progressive Human Resources experience in People Operations, HR Generalist, HR Specialist, Employee Relations, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, or HR Business Partner support roles.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting multiple HR disciplines, including recruiting, employee relations, performance management, learning and development, talent management, total rewards, and HR operations.

  • Experience partnering with leaders in multi-site, operational, manufacturing, distribution, warehouse, or field-based environments preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with HR Centers of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Benefits, Learning & Development, HRIS, and Shared Services.
  • Working knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning, employee lifecycle management, change management, and organizational effectiveness principles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret workforce data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent consultation, facilitation, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Experience utilizing HRIS/HCM tools such as Oracle HCM Cloud, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar enterprise HR technology platforms.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)
  • Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese required; professional English proficiency required.
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on-site setting (listed in this posting), with estimated 30% travel for related meetings.

  • Food Ticket
  • Mobile Phone Plan

Sobre a AutoZone

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. No Brasil, a companhia mantém um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com mais de 167 lojas em sete estados — São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás — além de um escritório corporativo em São Paulo, localizado na Vila Leopoldina. Em 2025, foi inaugurado o Centro de Distribuição próprio em Paulínia/SP, fortalecendo a estrutura logística e sustentando a estratégia de expansão no país.

A AutoZone tem como princípios a mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e o compromisso de ir além.   • Atuar como referência técnica no planejamento e execução de paradas programadas e de manutenção, avaliando riscos relacionados à automação, instrumentação e controle e propondo soluções que assegurem a continuidade operacional.

  • Desenvolver e implantar soluções de monitoramento on-line, alarmes inteligentes, dashboards, indicadores, plataformas de dados industriais e análises preditivas para suporte à tomada de decisão e melhoria do desempenho operacional.
  • Administrar tecnicamente programas, lógicas de controle, backups, versionamento, documentação, gestão de mudanças, controle de acessos e segurança das informações dos sistemas de automação.
  • Avaliar tecnicamente equipamentos, instrumentos, sistemas, projetos de engenharia e fornecedores, elaborando estudos, pareceres, memórias de cálculo, especificações e recomendações para aquisição, implantação, modernização e melhorias.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos por meio da automação, instrumentação, digitalização e novas tecnologias, contribuindo para redução de perdas, aumento da eficiência energética, disponibilidade dos ativos e competitividade operacional.
  • Desenvolver análises de desempenho das malhas de controle, propondo ajustes de sintonia, melhorias das estratégias de controle, racionalização de alarmes e otimização dos processos.
  • Implantar soluções de monitoramento preditivo, detecção de anomalias, gatilhos, níveis de alerta e análises de desempenho de equipamentos, processos e sistemas de controle utilizando dados industriais.
  • Garantir a governança, integridade, disponibilidade, rastreabilidade, qualidade e segurança dos dados provenientes dos sistemas de automação e instrumentação.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a elaboração, priorização e gestão dos investimentos (CAPEX) e custos operacionais (OPEX) relacionados à automação, indicando iniciativas de maior retorno operacional e financeiro.
  • Garantir que procedimentos, padrões, instruções técnicas e documentação de automação permaneçam atualizados, padronizados, auditáveis e conforme normas técnicas e requisitos legais.
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz de falhas e incidentes críticos relacionados aos sistemas de automação e controle, definindo planos de ação estruturados para eliminação das causas recorrentes.
  • Desenvolver soluções internas que reduzam a dependência de fornecedores externos, preservem o conhecimento técnico da organização, reduzam custos e aumentem a agilidade de resposta.
  • Integrar sistemas e dados de automação às plataformas corporativas de manutenção, produção, qualidade, gestão de ativos, analytics e desempenho industrial.
  • Atuar na gestão dos riscos relacionados à cibersegurança industrial, apoiando a implementação de controles de acesso, segregação de redes, gestão de vulnerabilidades e proteção dos ativos digitais da planta.
  • Representar tecnicamente a área de Instrumentação, Controle e Automação em projetos estratégicos, auditorias, inspeções, reuniões técnicas, fóruns corporativos e interface com fornecedores.
  • Orientar, capacitar, desenvolver e mentorar engenheiros, técnicos e equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo a disseminação das melhores práticas de instrumentação, automação, programação, confiabilidade e gestão de sistemas industriais.
  • Realizar prospecção tecnológica, benchmarking e avaliação de soluções inovadoras aplicáveis à automação industrial, conectividade, analytics, inteligência operacional e transformação digital, visando aumentar a confiabilidade, eficiência operacional e competitividade das unidades industriais.

title: Analista Tributário PL
description:
Analista Tributário PL

Sobre a Empresa

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

title: Senior Market Research Analyst
description:
About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.

Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.

Introduction:

We are looking for a senior market research analyst to join our amazing team in Brazil! You are the ideal candidate for this role if you have at least 4 years of market research experience, ideally on the supplier side. In this position, you will be responsible for leading the full project life cycle, from set-up through client presentations.

You’ll work across multiple research methodologies within Product & Innovation (idea and concept testing, market exploration, and packaging testing) and Brand & Communication (advertising testing, media and campaign effectiveness, brand assessment) in a dynamic environment, where AI-powered solutions are already a reality.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and execution of research projects to meet complex needs with minimal support.
  • Independently manage medium-to-highly complex quantitative & qualitative studies across a variety of methodologies from survey design through final delivery to clients.
  • Develop compelling, story-led analyses and final reports with strategic, clear, and engaging client presentations.
  • Responsible for leading final client presentations, providing consistent, clear, and actionable recommendations.
  • Manage all client communications, providing clear and proactive communication regarding project progress.
  • Manage multiple projects at once in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work together with project managers and operations for deployment and execution while maintaining overall management of timelines.
  • Share your expertise with junior and mid-level research analysts, acting as a knowledge multiplier and recognized as a strong technical contributor within the team.

Your profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 4 years of market research experience.
  • Experience in various research methodologies such as ad-hoc, ad concept testing, ad pre-testing, campaign evaluation, pack testing, brand tracking, shopper research, segmentation, U&A, iHUTs, etc.
  • Demonstrated success in questionnaire design, analysis, client presentation, and project management.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop effective working relationships with both internal partners and external clients.
  • Languages: English proficiency is mandatory; additional language skills are a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills with an ability to multitask and effectively prioritize own workload.

**Please submit your CV in English

Our Values:

A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring

What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.

Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher, TotalPass and language class subsidy.

Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

A AutoZone é uma empresa americana e multinacional, listada na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York, reconhecida como a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo. Atualmente, possui mais de 7.000 lojas distribuídas pelos Estados Unidos, Porto Rico, México e Brasil, com o apoio de mais de 100.000 AutoZoners em quatro continentes.

  • Conhecimento em mecânica automotiva (diferencial);

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.

Venha crescer com a AutoZone e impulsionar o futuro da sua carreira!

  • Conhecimento de práticas de compliance e controles internos aplicados à governança;

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.

Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.

What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.

Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.

Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Gestor Financeiro de Turismo
description:
Gestor Financeiro | Bittale Travel

Sobre a Bittale Travel

A Bittale Travel é uma boutique de viagens de luxo. Desenhamos roteiros sob medida — luas de mel, viagens de celebração e, mais recentemente, viagens corporativas —, cuidando de cada detalhe da experiência do cliente, do primeiro contato ao retorno para casa.

Somos um time enxuto, o que significa que cada pessoa tem autonomia real e vê o impacto do próprio trabalho no negócio.

A vaga

Procuramos alguém para assumir a área financeira da agência de ponta a ponta. Hoje a rotina financeira está distribuída entre a operação e a contabilidade externa, e queremos centralizá-la em uma pessoa que organize, controle e traga previsibilidade para o caixa.

É uma posição para quem gosta de estrutura: montar processo onde ainda não existe, fechar números com precisão e dar ao time comercial uma leitura clara de quanto a agência está realmente ganhando em cada venda.

Responsabilidades

  • Contas a pagar e a receber — controle de vencimentos, conciliação bancária e gestão do fluxo de caixa
  • Comissões — apuração e conferência das comissões de fornecedores, consolidadores e operadoras, reserva a reserva, e cálculo das comissões dos consultores
  • Faturamento — emissão de notas e cobrança, incluindo clientes corporativos com faturamento consolidado
  • Fechamento mensal — organização dos lançamentos de vendas, envio de documentação e interlocução com a contabilidade externa
  • Operações em moeda estrangeira — controle de recebimentos e pagamentos em dólar e euro, com acompanhamento de câmbio
  • Relatórios gerenciais — margem por venda, por consultor e por fornecedor, com apoio à tomada de decisão dos sócios

O que buscamos

  • Experiência em agências de viagem, operadoras ou turismo em geral é imprescindível
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão de agências - STUR
  • Experiência consolidada em rotinas financeiras (contas a pagar/receber, conciliação, fechamento)
  • Domínio de Excel ou Google Sheets
  • Familiaridade com operações em múltiplas moedas
  • Perfil organizado e detalhista — nesse trabalho, uma comissão conferida errado passa despercebida por meses
  • Autonomia e boa comunicação escrita: o time é remoto e a rotina depende de gente que reporta bem sem precisar ser cobrada

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com empresa que tenha entidade no exterior
  • Inglês para comunicação com fornecedores internacionais

Formato

  • 100% remoto , de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo
  • Horário comercial, com flexibilidade
  • Regime de contratação: PJ
  • Remuneração: a definir

Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para  com o assunto "Gerente Financeiro". Conte em poucas linhas qual foi a rotina financeira mais bagunçada que você já organizou e o que você fez para arrumá-la.

description:

title: Coordenador(a) de Qualidade
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Se você é um profissional de Qualidade em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta vaga é para você.

Você será responsável por coordenar as atividades do time de Qualidade com responsabilidade pela gestão das pessoas, interfaces e qualidade das soluções técnicas.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Coordenar as atividades do Departamento da Qualidade, garantindo o atendimento aos requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (ISO 9001) e demais normas aplicáveis;

  • Coordenar o processo de homologação, avaliação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, acompanhando indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação;
  • Suportar processos de certificação e manutenção de certificados de produtos, acompanhando ensaios laboratoriais e documentação técnica junto aos órgãos certificadores;
  • Garantir a conformidade dos produtos com requisitos normativos, regulatórios e especificações de clientes;
  • Elaboração de Data Book – Petrobras;
  • Gerenciar processos de calibração de equipamentos de medição e monitoramento, garantindo rastreabilidade metrológica;
  • Coordenar inspeções de recebimento, processo e produto final, assegurando o cumprimento dos critérios de aceitação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com Engenharia, Produção, Supply Chain e Atendimento ao Cliente na resolução de problemas de qualidade;
  • Suportar projetos de melhoria contínua utilizando ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e Lean Six Sigma;
  • Elaborar apresentações gerenciais, reportando indicadores, riscos e planos de ação à liderança.

Quem você é:

Você apresenta elevado nível de atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com a qualidade, assegurando aderência rigorosa às diretrizes, instruções e padrões de processo estabelecidos pela organização. Combinando pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis. Constrói relacionamentos baseados em confiança, escutando ativamente e ajustando sua abordagem conforme o contexto e as necessidades dos clientes, transmitindo mensagens de forma clara, convincente e concisa.. Você prevê conflitos antes que eles aconteçam, com base no conhecimento da dinâmica interpessoal e de grupo. A função exige, ainda, disciplina operacional, responsabilidade e zelo constante pelas pessoas, organização, segurança e ambiente de trabalho.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Qualidade, Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência com qualificação de fornecedores e auditorias de qualidade;
  • Inglês avançado (para contato com fornecedores internacionais);
  • Conhecimento da ISO 9001;
  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência liderando equipes na área de Qualidade e laboratório de Qualidade;
  • Conhecimentos avançados com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas;
  • Local de trabalho: Barueri, SP.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Desejável Pós Graduação em Gestão / Engenharia da Qualidade e Certificações relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento em Ferramentas Lean Manufacturing e 6-Sigma;
  • Conhecimento em ERP Omega da ABC71
  • Familiaridade com pacote office 365 e suas ferramentas
  • Leitura e interpretação de documentos em inglês

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Analista Fiscal Diretos

Backed as an independent subsidiary of one of the world's most respected global agricultural machinery giants, they combine the agile, fast-paced environment of a high-tech startup with the massive scaling power of an industry leader. Their mission is to improve global food production, increase farming profitability, and protect the environment by dramatically reducing pesticide use.

THE ROLE: FIELD APPLICATION ENGINEER (BRAZIL)

We are seeking a hands-on Field Application Engineer based in Brazil to help develop, support, and maintain next-generation "smart" farm machines. In this role, you will be the bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will carry out in-field product testing, troubleshoot complex electro-mechanical systems, and provide the crucial feedback needed to drive continuous product development.

This is an immediate-start opportunity with exciting potential to travel to the United States during the Brazilian off-season.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Field Application Engineer, your primary focus will be supporting smart machinery performance directly in the field:

  • In-Field Testing: Carry out hardware, software, and machine vision field tests on mechatronic agricultural machinery, providing detailed execution reports and documentation.
  • Technical Support: Collect field data, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues on-site.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the vital link between customers, product management, agronomy, and engineering to communicate real-world user needs.
  • Documentation: Assist engineering teams in creating comprehensive product documentation, user guides, and instructional materials.
  • Systems Management: Track and manage recurring technical issues from initial identification to final resolution.
  • Logistics & Setup: Perform hands-on setup, maintenance, calibration, and transport of field-testing equipment as required.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Minimum Requirements:

  • Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Agriculture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Experience supporting, troubleshooting, or maintaining complex agricultural electro-mechanical systems (large machinery).
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose complex systems spanning hardware, software, and mechanical components.
  • Communication & Mindset: Excellent customer-facing skills with a collaborative, team-oriented attitude.
  • Mobility: Valid driver's license with a safe driving record, and a strong willingness to travel frequently to agricultural fields.

Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred but not required):

  • Familiarity with Linux environments and basic script programming.
  • Experience in designing and executing Design Verification Testing (DVT).
  • Basic programming/scripting skills in Python.
  • Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is an active, hands-on role in an outdoor environment. You should be comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing in various weather conditions (hot and cold).
  • Ability to frequently lift/move items up to 25 pounds (and occasionally up to 50 pounds).
  • Strong visual acuity (including color vision and depth perception) to work with advanced camera and machine vision systems.

WHAT'S ON OFFER

  • Competitive Compensation Package with a highly collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking work culture.
  • Fully Equipped: All tools, specialized equipment, and work vehicles are provided by the employer.
  • Travel Covered: 100% reimbursement for all work-related travel expenses.
  • Global Exposure: Unique opportunities for international collaboration and travel to US headquarters.

title: Cost Controller
description:
About the job

Come Join our Family Today!

Together, We Make Travel Better!

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Cost Controller to oversee Food & Beverage cost control, inventory accuracy, pricing integrity, and operational compliance. This professional will play a key role in monitoring cost performance, identifying variances, improving internal controls, and supporting both Finance and Operations to ensure efficiency and profitability across F&B outlets.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Able to effectively control the Food & Beverage Cost.
  • Control the Food and Beverage outlets in terms of wastage, pilferage and efficiency.
  • Prepare variance analysis for food & beverage and communicating with relevant parties.
  • Update and maintain receipts into the systems (FMC).
  • Check and verify voids in the POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis systems.
  • Check and verify discounts on the POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis systems.
  • Check and verify any happy hours discounts.
  • Check and verify all complimentary sales in POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis systems.
  • Check and verify all staff meals, ENT and staff discounts.
  • Check and verify all Event Package meals.
  • Check and verify all settlements done on the POS system.
  • Check and cross verify if all sales have been transferred correctly to the Property Management systems (PMS).
  • Check and verify for any lost postings.
  • Check the cost of sales in all F&B outlets and ensure that the costs are within budget.
  • Check the menu pricing on the POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis systems and ensure the correct prices are loaded.
  • Tally all end of shift reports generated from all POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis tills.
  • Continuously study weaknesses in F&B control implemented at the Hotel and provide suggestions for improvements.
  • Check the daily Food & Beverage revenues report submitted by the income audit for the accuracy of covers and average check.
  • Responsible for linking the articles and Recipes in Material Control.
  • Responsible for preparing daily Food and Beverage Report and distribute to management.
  • Responsible for monthly F&B Report and distribute to management.
  • Responsible for surprise spot checks at all F&B outlets.
  • Prepare Duty Drinks and management report and confirm that this is as per entitlement.
  • Prepare the daily and monthly cost report department in relation to cost of sales.
  • Prepare daily staff meal cost report.
  • Participate in stock taking at the restaurants.
  • Spot check on the receiving department to ensure that the scales are correct and goods are checked for quality.
  • Check and ensure that no material is issued out from the store without requisition or approval from the respective department head.
  • Check and ensure all menu items have a recipe.
  • Coordinate with restaurant management and finance to sort out issues pertaining to F&B.
  • Update selling prices in POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis as per the instruction from authorised persons.
  • Maintain the security of the information held by the department.
  • Responsible to maintain the Menu Pricing, Consumption and POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis systems.
  • Any other tasks as and when required by the management.

About you:

  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Good analytics and reporting skills.
  • Experience with Accounting System, POS, WAS, Point soft, Sun & Oasis Systems and cost and inventory systems.
  • Ability to multitask, work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have a high-level attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and to collaborate with others to promote an environment of teamwork.

title: Global Sales Support Specialist (Contractor)
description:
Role Description

The Global Sales Support Specialist (GSS) is a critical driver of revenue within the Sales Finance organization, empowering the Field Sales Team with expert support in complex quoting, order processing, and product configuration. As a subject matter expert, the GSS ensures seamless deal execution while collaborating across functions to streamline processes and maximize efficiency.

This fast-paced role demands a proactive, highly organized individual who thrives under pressure. The GSS directly engages with internal sales and business operations teams to optimize sales execution, enable new product introductions, and keep quoting operations running smoothly and effectively.

  • Location - Sao Paulo - HYBRID/ 3 days in office or 70% in office throughout the month
  • Duration - 12 months

Your Impact

This position calls for someone who possesses good communication skills, sense of ownership, proactiveness and maturity working with confidential and sensitive information. This person is a self-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and quick to action in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment.

Sales Support Excellence:

  • Support the Field Sales Team with quoting complex deals, responding to order inquiries, and providing guidance on product configurations in SFDC CPQ. Facilitate training on quote-to-order processes, including SFDC quoting sessions, ensuring that our Sales team members are equipped with the knowledge needed to drive sales success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with teams including Deal Review, Pricing, Product, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure the smooth implementation of business policies, scalable quoting processes, and GTM offerings in SFDC CPQ.

Process Documentation & Best Practices:

  • Collaborate with the documentation team to ensure that our quoting decks are accurate, well-structured, and aligned to drive sales success. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in new product introductions, helping to design and refine quoting best practices for both new and existing products, ensuring clarity and consistency across all enablement materials.

System & Process Improvement:

  • Serve as a key partner in driving business requirements for system enhancements in SFDC CPQ, actively participating in the testing and UAT process to ensure new functionalities align with business needs. Identify and escalate system gaps or opportunities for process improvements, collaborating to streamline workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.

GTM Readiness & Operational Coordination:

  • Ensure the operational readiness of new GTM offers by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable seamless execution of new product offerings. Build strong relationships with internal teams (Product, Sales, Legal, IT, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth quoting processes.

Project Management & Communication:

  • Work with business partners to define objectives, set timelines, and track the status of quoting changes. Communicate milestones, dependencies, and project status updates to key stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.

Prioritization & Execution:

  • Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.

Your Experience

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a SaaS or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes.

Communication & Collaboration:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment.

Organizational & Analytical Skills:

  • Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements.

Additional Requirements:

  • Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support.
  • Language: Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Information about Palo Alto Networks

At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

title: BIM Engineer- Mechanical
description:
About CTS Group

CTS Group is a fast-growing international design and build company specialising in data centre

development across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). We combine engineering excellence, innovation, and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable, and future-ready data centre solutions.

With over 40 nationalities represented across our teams, CTS fosters a culture of innovation,

collaboration, and excellence — combining engineering expertise with manufacturing capability to deliver high-performance, sustainable data centre solutions at speed and scale.

With a proven track record and strong partnerships, CTS is a trusted leader in delivering large-scale, complex data centre facilities with speed, efficiency, and excellence.

Role Overview

The BIM Mechanical Engineer supports the development, coordination, and delivery of mechanical (HVAC, cooling, piping) BIM/Revit models for hyperscale and colocation data centre projects. Working within CTS's São Paulo engineering hub, the role bridges mechanical engineering knowledge with BIM modelling and coordination practice — ensuring mechanical models are accurate, clash-free, and aligned with project standards, client requirements, and applicable codes. The scope and level of ownership vary by experience band, from supporting model development under supervision (Junior), to owning mechanical model delivery end-to-end (Intermediate), to defining BIM strategy and holding technical sign-off authority for the mechanical discipline (Senior).

This is an opportunity to build specialist expertise in mechanical BIM coordination within a fast-track, multidisciplinary project environment, alongside experienced engineers across CTS's global project portfolio.

Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain coordinated mechanical BIM/Revit models covering HVAC, cooling, piping, ductwork, and associated plant systems from concept through IFC and as-built stages.
  • Produce mechanical drawings, schematics, equipment layouts, ductwork and pipe routing, schedules, quantities, and model-based deliverables.
  • Perform or support clash detection and multidisciplinary coordination using Navisworks and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or equivalent common data environments.
  • Coordinate mechanical model interfaces with electrical, structural, architectural, vendor, and OEM stakeholders to achieve accurate, constructible, clash-free outputs.
  • Develop and maintain model content in accordance with the BIM Execution Plan, level of detail/information requirements, naming conventions, ISO 19650 principles, and project quality standards.
  • Support the selection, sizing, layout, and BIM integration of mechanical equipment such as chillers, CRAHs, AHUs, pumps, CDUs, and heat-rejection systems, according to role capability.
  • Review or support the review of vendor and OEM technical submittals, equipment data, and model content for BIM integration.
  • Prepare model views, clash reports, bills of quantities, material take-offs, equipment schedules, RFIs, technical submittals, and other engineering documentation.
  • Participate in model audits, integrated design reviews, coordination meetings, technical workshops, site-query resolution, and commissioning activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of mechanical BIM standards, digital workflows, model quality, and team capability; guide colleagues where appropriate.

title: Head de Crédito e Risco
description:
A CIX Capital é uma gestora de recursos especializada em investimentos imobiliários, com atuação no Brasil e nos Estados Unidos. Como braço de mercado de capitais do Grupo Maiz, origina, estrutura e gere operações de crédito e equity .

Buscamos um(a) Head de Crédito e Risco que será o(a) principal responsável pela condução da análise técnica, definição da recomendação de crédito e sustentação das operações perante o Comitê de Investimentos, exercendo papel decisivo na avaliação e estruturação das operações, e monitoramento da recuperação dos créditos.

Procuramos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em crédito estruturado, análise de risco e mercado de capitais, que combine visão estratégica, elevado rigor técnico e autonomia para conduzir operações complexas no segmento imobiliário .

Como será o dia a dia?

Na área de Crédito e Risco, o(a) profissional será responsável por:

  • Liderar a análise de operações de crédito corporativo e estruturado, com foco em ativos imobiliários;
  • Conduzir análises econômico-financeiras completas, incluindo avaliação de demonstrações financeiras, fluxo de caixa, liquidez, alavancagem, capacidade de pagamento e estrutura de capital;
  • Estruturar operações de crédito, definindo garantias, covenants, mitigadores de risco e demais condições da operação;
  • Elaborar memorandos de investimento, pareceres técnicos e materiais executivos para suporte às decisões do Comitê de Investimentos;
  • Definir recomendações técnicas sobre aprovação, reprovação ou reestruturação das operações, assumindo a responsabilidade pelas análises realizadas;
  • Apresentar operações ao Comitê de Investimentos, sustentando tecnicamente as recomendações e conduzindo discussões relacionadas aos riscos e oportunidades de cada operação;
  • Monitorar continuamente a carteira de crédito e investimentos, cobrança, acompanhando indicadores financeiros, covenants, performance dos ativos e eventos relevantes;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar políticas, metodologias, processos e controles relacionados à análise e gestão de crédito;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Investimentos, Jurídico, Estruturação e Relações com Investidores durante todo o ciclo das operações;
  • Contribuir para a estratégia de investimentos da gestora, apoiando a identificação de oportunidades e a evolução das práticas de gestão de risco e crédito.

O que esperamos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em análise e estruturação de operações de crédito corporativo, crédito estruturado ou investimentos no segmento imobiliário ;
  • Experiência com crédito imobiliário, Private Equity Imobiliário ou investimentos estruturados;
  • Conhecimento em CRI, FIDC, Debêntures, Fundos Imobiliários (FII) e demais instrumentos do mercado de capitais;
  • Experiência em gestoras de investimentos ou outras instituições do mercado financeiro que atuaram com produtos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em análise de demonstrações financeiras, modelagem financeira, finanças corporativas e avaliação de risco de crédito;
  • Experiência na elaboração e apresentação de operações para Comitês de Crédito ou Comitês de Investimentos;
  • Histórico de participação em processos de tomada de decisão de crédito e definição de recomendações técnicas;
  • Capacidade de conduzir negociações e interagir com diferentes stakeholders internos e externos;
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico, proativo, com autonomia, elevado senso crítico e foco em resultados.

Será um diferencial:

  • Certificações como CGA, CGE, CFA, CFP ou similares;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Regional Sales Representative —Curitiba, Paraná

Department: Sales — IoT/M2M Connectivity

Location: Paraná, Brazil — field-based and remote work, with frequent regional travel

Employment Type: Full-Time (CLT or PJ, to be defined based on candidate profile)

Reports To: Head of Sales LATAM

Role Context

We are expanding our commercial team in Brazil with dedicated territorial coverage by region. Paraná is part of the first front of this expansion, given the volume of strategic accounts already established in the area and the active presence of competitors (Virtueyes, Datatem, Allcom, among others).

What You'll Do

  • Prospect, develop, and close deals with medium and large companies in Paraná, focused on fleet management, asset tracking, and related IoT verticals.
  • Act as the local commercial point of contact, with recurring in-person presence at clients and prospects across Paraná.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline, from qualification through close, in coordination with the Head of Sales LATAM and the Inside Sales/SDR team.
  • Track and monitor local competitors (MVNOs and IoT connectivity providers operating in the region).
  • Present technical-commercial proposals, including products such as SIM DUO, vSIM, and eSIM, together with the Solutions team.
  • Negotiate contracts, commercial terms, and SLAs with corporate clients.
  • Report pipeline metrics, forecast, and results in a structured way.

What We Expect

Farm and Grow the Existing Base

  • Take ownership of and grow the accounts already established in Paraná, increasing volume and revenue within the current portfolio.
  • Keep clients satisfied through constant visits and recurring in-person presence — not just remote contact.
  • Ensure fast response to client requests and demands, acting as their trusted local point of contact.
  • Anticipate churn risk and act proactively to retain and expand strategic accounts.

Grow — Bring In New Accounts

  • Prospect and close new accounts quickly, with a strong sense of urgency and focus on results.
  • Directly contribute to revenue growth in the region, not just maintenance of the current portfolio.
  • Establish Acceleronix's active presence in Paraná — participation in events, trade shows, and visits that reinforce the brand locally.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of new business, without relying solely on leads handed over by the SDR team.

Requirements

Required

  • Based in Paraná, or willing to relocate to the region.
  • Proven track record in consultative B2B sales, preferably in telecom, connectivity, IoT/M2M, or technology.
  • Hybrid farmer/hunter profile — able to grow existing accounts while also generating and converting new pipeline.
  • Availability for frequent travel within the region.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, autonomy, and organization to manage a complex sales cycle.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at an MVNO, carrier, or IoT/M2M connectivity provider.
  • Familiarity with industry concepts: SIM DUO, vSIM, eSIM, national roaming, ICCID/IMSI/IMEI, LTE-M, NB-IoT.
  • Existing relationships with clients or partners in fleet management and vehicle tracking in Paraná.
  • Intermediate/advanced English, for interaction with the Quectel group.

About Acceleronix

Acceleronix is Quectel's integrated IoT platform and connectivity company, built to help businesses launch and scale connected products faster. The company provides consulting, PCBA design, global SIM connectivity, and a secure device management platform, bringing hardware, connectivity, and software together into a single, end-to-end offering rather than requiring customers to stitch together separate vendors.

Operating as part of the Quectel ecosystem, Acceleronix is positioned as a trusted end-to-end IoT partner delivering scalable, reliable solutions from design through deployment, and appears alongside Quectel at major industry events such as MWC and the World IT Show to showcase joint IoT deployments across smart agriculture, smart home, and connected-device use cases.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
  • Sales commission / performance bonus tied to new business and account growth
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage
  • Life insurance and accident cover
  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at , or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.

title: Estágio em Engenharia de Eficiência Energética
description:
Sobre a GreenYellow do Brasil

A GreenYellow é uma multinacional francesa especializada em transição energética, com foco em Eficiência Energética, Energia Solar, Armazenamento de Energia, Comercialização e Gestão Inteligente de Energia. Fundada em 2007 e presente no Brasil desde 2013, a companhia atua atualmente em mais de 15 países, apoiando empresas em sua jornada de descarbonização rentável e sustentável.

Seu modelo de negócios é baseado no conceito de Energy as a Service (EaaS), no qual a GreenYellow investe integralmente, desenvolve, constrói, opera e mantém soluções energéticas de longo prazo, permitindo que seus clientes reduzam custos, emissões e riscos operacionais sem necessidade de investimento próprio (CAPEX zero).

Globalmente, a GreenYellow possui um portfólio de mais de 3.500 projetos de eficiência energética, sendo mais de 1.400 no Brasil, atendendo empresas dos segmentos de varejo, indústria, telecomunicações, logística, mineração, serviços e infraestrutura. Em energia solar fotovoltaica, ultrapassa 930 MWp globalmente.

No Brasil, e empresa já construiu mais de 250 MWp em usinas fotovoltaicas, além de um pipeline crescente de projetos instalados junto à carga (behind-the-meter), que integram geração solar, armazenamento em baterias (BESS), eficiência energética e gestão de energia, sobretudo para clientes comerciais e industriais (C&I).

A GreenYellow posiciona-se como um player integrado de infraestrutura energética, combinando solução técnica, engenharia financeira, inteligência de dados e gestão contínua de ativos, com investimentos de longo prazo e foco na criação de valor sustentável para seus clientes.

Sobre a vaga

  • Produzir relatórios para os clientes, comprovando o atingimento do proposto em contrato;

title: Subject Matter Expert — Digital Commercial Operations
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Commercial operations for the Brazilian market runs through a wider chain than order-to-cash alone: product sales configuration and quoting, retail and dealer platform integrations, workshop uptime and warranty administration, and marketing/ecommerce touchpoints all sit on top of the same customer relationship. This SME is the on-the-ground domain authority for Digital Commercial Operations at the Curitiba site, covering Product Sales Operations, Retail Operations (dealer services, integrations and platforms), Workshop Operations (uptime, warranty), and Marketing & Service Sales Operations (service contracts, ecommerce, parts & service management, digital experience). The role requires someone who has lived inside a Brazilian dealer network or commercial sales operation, not just implemented a CRM from the IT side.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Define and validate requirements across the full Digital Commercial Operations scope at the Curitiba site — Product Sales Operations, Retail/Dealer Operations, Workshop Operations, and Marketing & Service Sales Operations — facilitated with local commercial stakeholders in Portuguese.

• Map current-state commercial process flows for the Brazilian dealer network — from lead and quote through order, delivery, invoicing, warranty activation and workshop uptime tracking — and identify transformation opportunities.

• Provide domain validation and business rules guidance for commercial platform configurations: CRM, dealer platforms/DMS, CPQ, O2C, warranty and workshop uptime systems.

• Engage Brazilian dealer and retail operations stakeholders alongside the client's Marketing & Service Sales and Software Engineering teams to validate ecommerce and digital experience requirements.

• Represent the Brazil site's Digital Commercial Operations perspective in programme governance, including sessions with the client's global Digital Commercial Operations leadership.

MUST-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Experience in commercial operations, order-to-cash, dealer/retail network management, or workshop/warranty operations within automotive, commercial vehicles, or heavy equipment, with direct Brazil market experience.

• Hands-on experience with CRM and commercial platforms — Salesforce, SAP CRM/S&D, or Dealer Management Systems (DMS) — including exposure to dealer integration or dealer platform tooling.

• Working knowledge of workshop/uptime and warranty administration processes, and how they connect to the broader commercial value chain.

• Fluent Portuguese (native or C1+) AND professional English — all dealer, retail and commercial stakeholder sessions will be conducted in Portuguese.

• Demonstrable SME, business analyst, or consulting experience on large-scale commercial transformation programmes.

NICE TO HAVE

• Prior experience in commercial or retail operations within a major commercial vehicle, truck, or heavy industrial OEM's Brazilian dealer network.

• Familiarity with ecommerce, digital experience platforms, or marketing/communications systems in a dealer-facing context.

• Knowledge of commercial analytics or BI platforms — Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, Tableau — in a sales or workshop reporting context.

title: Product Analyst - Vmake (AI Video & Content Creation)
description:

We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.

  • Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration.
  • Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch.
  • Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies.
